page_title: JT808--Local configuration import registration department standard platform
page_content:
[TOC]

### Prerequisites:
- The device network can access the Internet normally, for example: 4G dial-up is successful or wired network routing is successful or WiFi connection is successful, refer to the "Function Usage">>>"Network Function" article introduction!

### Operation steps:
1. Download this configuration file template [config.zip](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=e6e4c139fb0eabdd1e6f101c9def4133 "[config.zip") and unzip it locally
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=439939d4aeed81dabab0f3edc233bfa4)
1. Open the text editing tool and fill in "Open function" "Server IP" "Server port" "Mobile phone number" "Terminal ID number" Parameters such as . Please refer to the xml document parameter comments
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=4476ba9e916628338d7f2c2ef9aee9ce)

1. Unlock the device and remove the hard disk or SD card storage. Use a hard disk reader or SD card reader to insert it into the computer and open the root directory of the first partition of the storage
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=6a665965003a18a71cbee9142ce5f903)
1. Copy the config file you just edited and saved to this directory, disconnect the device, insert the device and lock it
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=59a3e48b230d029ceef9ee92d6469108)
1. When the device is powered on, it will automatically import the configuration and restart. The configuration will take effect after the restart
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=a7491d52f58c7cf79e922b12e4888352)
1. Check whether the registration is successful locally or check whether the platform is online
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=87424c8a22b4e8c0e916d3f47e04569a)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=6d535f47b9c41f85b32096371959e20f)
